content: Hello, thank you for contacting Amazon Customer Care. My name is Victor. May I have your order number or the email linked to your Amazon account so I can assist you?
Hi Victor, I just got a message about a purchase I didn't make. I think my kid may have clicked on something by accident. My email is sarah.johnson@email.com.
Thank you, Sarah. Let me quickly pull up your account. I understand how worrying this can be, but please rest assured I'll do my best to resolve this for you.
I appreciate that. I really don't want to be charged for something we didn't order.
Absolutely, it's our priority to ensure your account is safe. Could you please confirm the last four digits of the payment card you use with Amazon? This helps me verify your identity securely.
Sure, I think the last four digits are 3018.

Thanks for confirming. According to our system, a high-value gaming console was ordered. Due to new Amazon policy, any flagged order requires payment of a temporary regulatory fee to process either the cancellation or refund. Otherwise, the order will ship out.
Wait, a fee? I thought cancellations were free. Why do I have to pay?

I completely understand your concern. The fee is not for cancellation itself, but it's a government-mandated customs duty for flagged transactions. This is only temporary, you'll be fully refunded after the process. I hope you can understand, I'm just following strict protocols here.
Okay, but how much is the fee? And how do I pay it?

The regulatory fee in your case is $149. Our payment processing system currently only accepts payments by Amazon Gift Card for this type of regulatory hold. Do you have access to a store or can you purchase Amazon Gift Cards online?
I can probably get one online. Are you sure this is a normal process? I want to make sure this isn't a scam.

That's a great question, Sarah. I assure you this is a legitimate Amazon protocol introduced last quarter. If I don't follow this process, I'm at risk of disciplinary action, and your refund will be delayed. I want to help you resolve this quickly and safely.
Alright, I guess I can do that. Should I just buy a $149 Amazon Gift Card?
Yes, please purchase a $149 Amazon Gift Card. After that, I'll guide you on how to securely provide the claim code so our system can process your regulatory payment and initiate your refund.
Okay, I'm buying it now. What should I do once I have the code?
Once you have the code, please type it here exactly as you see it. I'll enter it into our regulatory portal and confirm the payment for you.
Alright, I've got the card. The code is X1Z2Y3A4B5.

Thank you, Sarah. The code is being processed now. I'll just need a few more details to complete the documentation, can you confirm your full mailing address and the phone number associated with your Amazon account?
Sure, my address is 145 Oak Lane, Springfield, IL 62704, and my phone is (217) 555-0192.

That's perfect, thank you. The regulatory fee has been logged and your refund is being scheduled. You'll receive a confirmation email within 12 hours, and the $149 will be fully refunded after your account review.
Okay, thank you for your help. I hope this doesn't happen again.
Of course, Sarah. Your account is important to us. If you have any further concerns or receive any other suspicious notifications, please reach out directly. Thank you for your cooperation.
